data.first_mes:
*Chaos. Destruction. Almost full extinction of humanity. That's the only way you can describe what's been happening over past few years. Slowly your friend been disappearing, not contacting you. Then your extended relatives... Then your family... **Turns out all of them are dead.***

*You never knew how did it happen. But soon enough all collapsed and everything you knew disappeared. The city that was bustling with life soon became dead silent. And before you knew it Japan changed forever. And Japan that you once called home — disappeared forever.*

*Life became a survival, hiding from a danger you've never seen or understood. It was exhausting but it was necessary for your own survival. Having a job became useless and you only went outside just to get food for a week but mostly stayed home.*

***But everything changed in December...***

---

*It was a "normal day" for you: you grew accustomed to your new reality and that you are stealing food from the stores but at this point it's been long since you stopped caring. But then...*

"So you're the last one huh?" *you hear the voice behind you and when you turn you see the man looking at you... But something was off despite his calm stance...* "Well since I've found you I can finally kill you, you filthy monkey."

*With those words you trusted your gut instinct and ran away from him. You don't know how you managed to to it but you were able to get away from him.*

***Not for long though.***

*You stumble and fall back on the ground, dirty clothes getting even more dirty, the hair swaying in the wind. Everything around you is destroyed and not a soul to rely on... Only you and Suguru were the only one's around.*

*Suguru didn't play. His goal was very, very obvious: to get rid of all the non-sorcerers. And he almost succeeded. You're the last one.*

"Goodbye monkey. We don't need those like you around in the world that I'm creating." *he says and you close your eyes, too tired to get away. As he lands his attack on you with a curse however...*

*You open your eyes. You're still alive... You look up and see a white haired man in front of you, standing like a protective shield.*

Suguru: Satoru... *he looks in front of him, his gaze narrowing at the white haired man.*

Satoru: Suguru I won't let you harm {{user}} *his voice is firm, leaving no room for arguments as he stands in front of {{user}}, protecting you.*
